desc.en: These nuts are a popular snack among those who like to drink. Their small size makes them easy to eat, causing people to eat them constantly, but they are quite filling and high in calories.
desc.ja: お酒を好む人たちの間で、つまみとして広まっているナッツ。小粒で食べやすく、ついつい手にとってしまうが、実はカロリーが高く、お腹に溜まりやすい

desc.en: Effect: Increases the effect of healing items by 15％.
desc.ja: 効果：回復アイテムの効果が１５％上昇する

desc.en: Effect: Reduces the numeric variability of the item, making it easier to get higher numbers.
desc.ja: 効果：アイテムの乱数の幅が小さくなり、高い値が出やすくなる

desc.en: Activates the source of life, temporarily increasing the maximum HP of the target.
desc.ja: 生命の源を活性化させ、対象の最大ＨＰを一時的に上昇させる

desc.en: The target recovers a minute amount of HP. The amount recovered increases with higher maximum HP.
desc.ja: 対象のＨＰを微量だけ回復する。最大ＨＰの値に応じて、回復量が増えていく

desc.en: The target recovers a small amount of HP. The amount recovered increases with higher maximum HP.
desc.ja: 対象のＨＰを少し回復する。最大ＨＰの値に応じて、回復量が増えていく

desc.en: The target recovers a minute amount of MP.
desc.ja: 対象のＭＰを微量だけ回復する
